description: This file contains SASS/SCSS mixins related to border-radius styling, including helper functions and various mixins for applying border-radius to different sides and corners of elements.

methods.name: valid-radius
methods.description: A helper function that processes a list of radius values, replacing negative numbers with zero and returning the cleaned list.

methods.name: border-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to an element, with optional fallback, depending on whether rounding is enabled.

methods.name: border-top-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the top-left and top-right corners.

methods.name: border-end-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the top-right and bottom-right corners.

methods.name: border-bottom-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the bottom-right and bottom-left corners.

methods.name: border-start-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the top-left and bottom-left corners.

methods.name: border-top-start-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the top-left corner.

methods.name: border-top-end-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the top-right corner.

methods.name: border-bottom-end-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the bottom-right corner.

methods.name: border-bottom-start-radius
methods.description: A mixin that applies border-radius to the bottom-left corner.
